# SentinelX — AI-Powered Blockchain Security

## About
SentinelX is an AI-powered blockchain security platform that analyzes Ethereum smart contracts and token addresses to identify potential rug-pull indicators, honeypots, and security vulnerabilities.

## Key Features
- [Token Scanner](https://sentinelx.site/scan) — Analyze any Ethereum contract address or Solidity code
- [Features](https://sentinelx.site/features) — Explore all platform capabilities
- [How It Works](https://sentinelx.site/how-it-works) — Understand the analysis pipeline
- [Methodology](https://sentinelx.site/methodology) — Technical deep-dive into XGBoost ML and SHAP explainability

## Technical Details
- Backend: FastAPI + XGBoost ML model
- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Model: XGBoost classifier with 53 features
- Training Data: 2,400+ labeled Ethereum contracts
- Accuracy: 96.15% (evaluation metrics)
